# Template library — every shipped template

<!-- Generated by frontend/tool/build_template_catalogue.dart from resources/templates.md. Do not edit by hand. -->

**194 templates** in the app, in 72 categories and 17 supergroups (catalogue version 2.0.0, specification §13.4).

Every template is ordinary template data (§11.3). Each starter contains only its listed fields; record metadata, context, evidence and review history remain separate (§13.3). Pick one from **Templates → Library**, search it by name, code, category, record type or field, and add it to a project as an editable copy: rename, retype, reorder, hide or change the requiredness of any field (§13.2).

Requiredness marks: `*` suggested REQUIRED, `+` suggested RECOMMENDED, unmarked OPTIONAL. A unit follows the type in brackets.
